## SportsDataverse (sportsdataverse-data releases: hoopR NBA, fastRhockey NHL)
- Licence: **CC BY 4.0** badge on the release-store README — direct:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/main/README.md
- The producer repositories (`hoopR-nba-data`, `fastRhockey-nhl-data`) carry only a copyright-holder stub, no data
  licence text (direct). The hoopR package code is MIT.
- Upstream sources are ESPN, the NBA Stats API and the NHL web API. Their terms were not readable here (hosts
  blocked); search extracts indicate NBA.com and NHL.com terms restrict commercial reuse and scraping. Treat as
  **internal testing only**.
